title: Transfer Ownership
summary: Reads back what an ownership transfer moves and keeps, warns about an outside email or a recipient whose plan can't own it, and waits for acceptance.
description: Ownership transfer that reads back what moves and what you keep, warns when the email is outside your org with a one-tap switch to the colleague you probably meant, blocks a recipient whose plan can't own it, and transfers only once they accept, showing the pending request.
catches: Recipient email outside your organisation, with a likely internal match to switch to
Recipient plan too low to own the resource
What moves to them and what stays with you
Pending request and its expiry, with withdraw
limits: Recipient and plan data come from your props
The accept-before-transfer flow must be implemented by your backend
a11y: Section labelled by its title; email input has a <label>, aria-invalid on plan issues and a polite hint
Withdraw sets aria-busy while pending; state changes in a polite live region
server: Authorize the transfer server-side, require the recipient's acceptance, enforce plan eligibility and expire stale requests.
stops: Ownership transferred to the wrong email
